title: The template canvas: field rows, summaries and empty sections
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • A template with checkbox and per-axle fields and at least one empty section.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a field row shows its type, a summary line and its markers, which wrap rather than being cut off.
2. Confirm a checkbox's summary line lists its responses.
3. Confirm a per-axle field lists its measurement rows and notes that the technician adds axles while filling (kept on the builder's own list).
4. Confirm an empty section does not offer duplicate ways to add a field, the option to duplicate itself, or the add-section control until it has content.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A field row shows its type, a summary line and its markers, which wrap rather than being cut off.
  • A checkbox's summary line lists its responses.
  • A per-axle field's canvas row lists its measurement rows and notes that the technician adds axles while filling.
  • An empty section does not offer duplicate ways to add a field, the option to duplicate itself, or the add-section control until it has content.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R16: “A field row will show its type, a summary line, and its markers, which will wrap rather than being cut off”
  • S12-R17: “A checkbox's summary line will list its responses”
  • S12-R18: “A per-axle field will list its measurement rows and note that the technician adds axles while filling. This is the builder's canvas row, which is how an author scans a template, and it is deliberately kept — S12-N3 removes the descriptor from the surfaces the technician sees, not from the builder's own list”
  • S12-R19: “An empty section will not offer duplicate ways to add a field, the option to duplicate itself, or the add-section control, until it has content”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
